toolchain.compiler: Microsoft C/C++ Optimizing Compiler 17.00.50727.1 for x86

calling_conventions.rule: Rewrite only single-source-argument __thiscall/__fastcall callees to an extern __fastcall declaration, placing this in ECX.

verification.method: For each COFF .text REL32 field, resolve the decorated callee through inventory.tsv, patch target_va - (function_va + field_offset + 4), then compare every reconstructed code byte with the PE bytes at the declared IDB VA.
